contracts.name: Profile Scoped Thresholds
contracts.rule: Quality thresholds MUST be delivery/profile scoped; no single commercial/audio pacing threshold is globally canonical.

contracts.name: Independent Review
contracts.rule: A producer task MUST NOT be the sole independent reviewer or verifier for its own artifact.

contracts.name: Finding Identity
contracts.rule: Every finding MUST bind exact artifact digest and temporal/frame range when applicable.

contracts.name: Verification State
contracts.rule: Verification MUST distinguish FIXED, PARTIAL, STILL_PRESENT, REGRESSION and NOT_VERIFIABLE.

contracts.name: No Synthetic PASS
contracts.rule: NOT_VERIFIABLE, missing evidence or advisory model opinion MUST NOT be converted into PASS.

contracts.name: Evidence Chain
contracts.rule: Measurement, review, correction and verification receipts MUST preserve lineage.
